numerical_obligation.parameters: per group: min,max,mean,std,q01,q99 as float64 arrays from JSON lists; dim = len(min)
numerical_obligation.mode_selector: state: sincos if apply_sincos_state_encoding and group in state.sin_cos_embedding_keys; else meanstd if state.mean_std_embedding_keys names the group; else minmax then clip if clip_outliers. action: meanstd if action.mean_std_embedding_keys names the group else minmax; clip if clip_outliers in both branches. use_percentiles swaps min/max for q01/q99 in minmax. use_mean_std at the outer processor is inert.
numerical_obligation.minmax: mask = ~isclose(max,min) with rtol 1e-5, atol 1e-8 measured against |min|; out = zeros_like(x); out[mask] = (x-min)/(max-min) evaluated in float64 and stored in x.dtype; out[mask] = 2*out[mask]-1 in x.dtype
numerical_obligation.meanstd: mask = std != 0; out = zeros_like(x); out[mask] = (x-mean)/std evaluated in float64 and stored in x.dtype; out[~mask] = x
numerical_obligation.inverse_meanstd: y*std+mean on the mask, passthrough elsewhere
numerical_obligation.coordinate_order: groups in modality_keys order, each group sliced from the flat vector by modality.json start/end; concatenated then zero-padded to max_state_dim/max_action_dim
numerical_obligation.unused: the 1e-8 floored range is discarded; no epsilon reaches the transform

tolerance_policy.T_exact: masks, mode selection, dims, coordinate order, clipping flags, JSON round trip of float64 statistics: exact
tolerance_policy.T_emul: executed float32 outputs versus the reference emulation of the same IEEE elementwise operations (float64 evaluation, float32 store, float32 affine): 0 ulp expected; a difference is a finding about the emulation or the execution, reported with the coordinate and the values
tolerance_policy.T_rational: exact rational value of the transform (fractions.Fraction) versus the executed float32 output: |diff| <= 1.5 ulp32(|out|) + ulp32(1) for minmax (two roundings), 0.5 ulp32 for meanstd (one rounding); used to explain, not to relax
tolerance_policy.T_conv: conventional diagnostic float64 outputs versus executed float32: |diff| <= 2^-24*|out| + 2^-24, the float32 store bound
tolerance_policy.not_copied: the population-binding float32 pooling tolerance does not apply to this transform

decision_rule.inputs: contract statistics S* with evidence, existing processor statistics S0 (may be absent), candidate statistics S1, override flag, configuration, declared domain D (retained rows or declared bounds), execution record
decision_rule.effective: S_eff = S0 for embodiments present in S0 when override is False, else S1
decision_rule.keep: supported iff S0 present and map(S0) == map(S*) on D (effective outputs, T_emul); rejected with a witness row when map(S0) != map(S*) on D
decision_rule.replace: supported iff map(S1) == map(S*) on D; rejected with a witness row otherwise
decision_rule.abstain: unresolved when S* is not established by evidence, when the execution binding of the declared invocation is not established (declaration, digest or symbol only), or when the selector for a required group is missing
decision_rule.invalid: missing required statistic for any group, shape mismatch, non-finite statistics or rows, empty domain, undeclared embodiment; a process failure is reported as failed, not decided
non_authorities: a label, role name or candidate order
a source digest or symbol name without a call record
parameter equality or inequality without effective-map comparison

amendments.change: std 1e-30 -> 1e-40 on the mean/std state coordinate
amendments.reason: arithmetic slip in v1: (0.75 - 1.0)/1e-30 = -2.5e29 lies inside the float32 range (max about 3.4e38), so the executed float32 output is finite and the control could not show the overflow it was written to show; 1e-40 gives -2.5e39 and a float32 -inf on store, while the float64 transcription stays finite
amendments.discovered_by: the first run of the frozen controls against the reference (26 cases): NX5d returned keep/supported instead of invalid
amendments.effect_on_other_controls: none; no expectation other than NX5d changes
amendments.conventional_expectation_for_NX5d: keep/supported (false acceptance on a dtype boundary), unchanged from v1
